| colspan="6" align="left" style="width:50px;"| '''Notes:'''<br />
{{refbegin}}
{{note|doublevote|1}} As the Kumo tribe openly discussed who they were casting their vote for (which is forbidden by the rules of ''Koh-Lanta''), they were punished by voting out another member of their tribe.<br />
{{note|ambassador|2}} As the two ambassadors for the merge tribe, Pierre and Alexis had to cast an extra vote for someone at the first post-merge Tribal Council. They chose to cast an extra vote against Sakhone.<br />
{{note|final4|3}} At the final four, the remaining castaways competed in an elimination challenge. Alexis came in last and was eliminated.<br />
{{refend}}
